mod.loaded: Crop Harvesting QA loaded. Use the DTMAPI config page buttons, or bind optional scan/harvest hotkeys manually.
mod.configMenuMissing: DTMAPI config menu API is not available; bind optional hotkeys manually before using keyboard controls.
mod.name: Crop Harvesting QA
config.summary.empty: No crop QA operation has run yet.
config.boundary: Scope: crop-container API only. Tree-basin crops are scan-only/unsupported until their native owner is reviewed; grass, wild trees, and forage are not harvested by this API.
config.scanKey.name: Scan key
config.scanKey.tooltip: Runs a dry-run scan and logs kind/status counts.
config.harvestOneKey.name: Harvest one key
config.harvestOneKey.tooltip: Scans, then harvests one pending target by transient TargetId.
config.harvestBatchKey.name: Harvest batch key
config.harvestBatchKey.tooltip: Scans, then harvests up to Max harvests by transient TargetId.
config.maxHarvests.name: Max harvests
config.maxHarvests.tooltip: Maximum pending targets for the batch operation.
config.targetRows.name: Logged target rows
config.targetRows.tooltip: Maximum per-target rows written to the DTMAPI log after each operation.
config.includeOrdinary.name: Include ordinary crops
config.includeVines.name: Include vines
config.includeVines.tooltip: Includes PlantBasin-family targets classified as vines.
config.includeMushroomBags.name: Include mushroom bags
config.includeMushroomBags.tooltip: Includes PlantBasin-family targets classified as mushroom bags.
config.includeBushes.name: Include bushes
config.includeBushes.tooltip: Includes PlantBasin-family targets classified as bushes.
config.includeTreeBasinCrops.name: Show tree-basin crops
config.includeTreeBasinCrops.tooltip: Includes tree-basin crop targets in scan summaries; they remain unsupported/not executed by this API slice.
config.verboseTargets.name: Verbose target rows
config.verboseTargets.tooltip: Writes sample target rows with target kind, status, id, room, and message.
config.nativeMessage.name: Native harvest message
config.nativeMessage.tooltip: Passes SendNativeMessage to the harvest request.
config.button.harvestOne.tooltip: Scan and harvest the first pending target.
config.button.harvestBatch.tooltip: Scan and harvest up to Max harvests pending targets.
config.button.dumpLast.tooltip: Write the last operation summary to the DTMAPI log again.
